title: MCP servers (MCP Manager)
description: workspace/mcp-servers.json (offered to every project of the workspace) and workspace/projects/<id>/mcp-servers.json (only that project). Written by scripts/lib/mcp.ts. Values never hold credentials: they are ${VARIABLE} references read from the environment when a server starts. See docs/mcp-servers.md.

id.description: Stable (a rename keeps it) and unique in the whole workspace. Agents name it in their mcps contract.

command.description: stdio: a program name or absolute path, started without a shell.

url.description: http: the server's endpoint (http:// or https://).

access.description: execute: it changes things outside Moki; operation steps that use it wait for approval.

enabledByDefault.description: Workspace server: on in projects that did not choose (false by default for execute). Project server: on or off.
